assumptions.basis: the paper's own Tmax and T1/2 columns, and its AUC24 column, all reproduce over a 24 model-time-unit run; under the declared unit that run is 2400 hours
assumptions.chosen: the model's time unit is one hour, not the 3600*10^2 seconds it declares
assumptions.description: Every one of this paper's four deposited models declares its time unit as 3600*10^2 seconds — one hundred hours. An AUC read off such a model is, by the model's own units, in nmol*(100 h)/mL, while the paper's table prints nmol*h/mL. The dynamics settle it: Tmax, T1/2 and the AUC24 column all reproduce against a run of 24 model time units, which is 24 hours and not 2400. So the declared unit is read as an error in the deposit and the model's time is taken to be hours. Nothing but an AUC has a time dimension, so no Cmax claim rests on this.
